description: URL / malware safety scan. Checks whether a URL or domain is unsafe — phishing, malware, spam — and returns a risk score, domain reputation rank, content category, DNS validity, and domain age. Example: check_url({ url: "https://example.com" }) Requires your own IPQualityScore API key, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own IPQualityScore API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free tier at ipqualityscore.com; the key is on the account dashboard.

url.description: Full URL or domain to scan, e.g. "https://example.com"

name: check_url
title: Check Url
